newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka tenders to buy March diesel and kerosene.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka tenders to buy March diesel and kerosene.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) has issued a tender to buy gas oil and illuminating kerosene for March 1-2 arrival, industry sources said on Tuesday.
The tender seeks 65,000 barrels each of 1.0 percent and 0.5 percent gas oil and 15,000 barrels of kerosene on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Trincomalee, northeast of Sri Lanka.
The tender closes on February 13 and offers are valid for two days.
In its last tender, CPC bought 180,000 barrels of 1.0 percent gas oil and 120,000 barrels of jet A-1 at 58 cents over Singapore spot quotes on a c-and-f Colombo basis.
